description: Turn Attack Mode on or off. Turn it on only after the person said yes to the quote's confirmation, with that quote_id and a unique idempotency_key you keep for retries. On while already on returns the current activation and charges nothing; a retry with the same idempotency_key returns the same activation. Exit is free. (capability: company.settings_own)

company.description: The company to act for, by its domain (for example aioseo.com), one of those list_companies shows. Needed only when your key reaches more than one company.

name: set_attack_mode
